Kaminimadvidhunan Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Vajikaranadhikar 1131/64-65 
 Introduction 
 Kaminimadvidhunan rasa is a classical Ayurvedic medicine and used as Aphrodisiac. It increases the sperm count and is used in all types of Prameha (Diabetes). 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada ( Purified Mercury ) – 1 Part 
 Shuddha Gandhak ( Purified Sulphur ) – 1 Part 
 Shuddha Dhatura beej (Purified Datura metel ) – 1 Part 
 Dhatura Beej Tail (Oil of Datura metel seeds) – 1 Part 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified form of Mercury is used in several diseases. They enhance the strength of the body and also boost up the immunity. It also stimulates digestive power. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – It is a pure form of Sulphur which is useful in encouraging blood circulation. It maintains the pH of blood. It purifies the blood and hence maintains proper circulation. 
 Shuddha Dhatura Beej – It is a traditional Indian and alternative medicine. It has analgesic properties. It also acts as sedative and expectorant. It is useful in improving digestion. Before using the seeds of this herb, it requires a series of detoxification and purification processes. It also helps in reproductive problems. 
 Dhatura Beej Tail – This oil is beneficial in all types of pain. It is also helpful in subsiding the inflammation. It maintains the proper blood circulation. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Prepare Parada and Gandhak kajjali. 
 Then mix Dhatura Beej powder in this kajjali. 
 Give 1 bhavna with Dhatura Beej Tail and keep in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kaminimadvidhunan rasa is an old medicine used in reproductive health since 1000 years ago. It also maintains the proper functioning of the pancreas and hence manages diabetes. It enhances the proper circulation to the genitals. Kaminimadvidhunan rasa increases the sperm count and is very beneficial in oligospermia, azoospermia etc. 
 Indications

 Erectile Dysfunction 
 Diabetes 
 
 Dosage 
 60 mg twice daily with khandsharkra (Jaggery). 
 Cautions 
 
 Avoid in Pregnancy and children. 
 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
